يستكشفون (form X)
# يَسْتَكْشِفُونَ (yastakšifūna) /jas.tak.ʃi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# يُسْتَكْشَفُونَ (yustakšafūna) /jus.tak.ʃa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
